mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect a high of 74 degrees with overcast conditions near Reddan Soccer Park and a waning gibbous moon phase.

The City of Verona has officially installed a new Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park. This beautiful piece was carved from a reclaimed ash tree by artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland and donated by Gerri Gurman.

There is plenty to do today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, and trivia tonight at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus tomorrow.
Regarding the weekly police report, on August 25, officers responded to a medical emergency and successfully deployed an AED to restore a pulse to a local resident.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
